name: Emotional Quotient Inventory (EQ-i 2.0)
description: A 133-item self-report measure of emotional and social functioning across five composites: Self-Perception, Self-Expression, Interpersonal, Decision Making, and Stress Management.
reputation: Most widely used commercial EI measure; strong normative database; used in selection and coaching.
notes: Self-report susceptible to faking; measures trait EI, not ability EI.
